validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and well-documented. P7715 = 'Shedgum Riyadh Gas 2' (SRG-2), the shorter of the two lines in Saudi Aramco Master Gas System Expansion (MGSE) Phase 2, Package 3 'Eastern Region Pipeline'. Corroborated by four INDEPENDENT non-GEM sources that all name the SRG-2 line: (1) lamar-industrial.com (EPC contractor project page) describes two 56-in pipelines in this package - Pipeline 1 ~150 km EWPS #1->BGCS #3 (SRG-3) and Pipeline 2 ~40 km BGCS #3->KM 245.2 (SRG-2 SEC III); (2) dmsprojects.net (PRJ00021820) independently states '150 km of 56 in on Shedgum Riyadh Gas Pipeline 3' and '40 km of 56 in on Shedgum Riyadh Gas 2', owner Saudi Aramco, status Completed; (3) MEED coverage of the MGS expansion contractor selection; (4) C.A.T. Group project page for 'MGS Expansion SRG-2 Pipeline' (Aramco contract 6600019233). No gem.wiki page backs this row and none needed. CLASSIFICATION: correct - a 56-in gas TRANSMISSION trunk loop within the Master Gas System, not gathering/process/oil. Fuel=Gas correct. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate. P7714 (Shedgum Riyadh Gas 3 / SRG-3, 150 km) and P7715 (SRG-2, 40 km) are the two DISTINCT lines that make up Package 3; GEM correctly split them, and both lamar and DMS list them as separate lines. Not the same physical pipe as the East-West main (P3962, 1200 km to Yanbu). ATTRIBUTION: owner/operator = Saudi Aramco (confirmed by DMS + program docs). SPEC: length 40 km and diameter 56 in both AGREE across lamar + DMS (two independent sources) => high. CAVEATS: (a) DATE - GEM StartYear1=2021, but the lamar contractor page lists Award 2015 / Completion 2018; the MGSE program targeted 12.5 BSCFD by 2020, so an operating date of 2020-2021 is defensible and lamar's 2015/2018 look like planning-era figures - minor, unresolved. (b) COST - GEM SegmentCost=$117.0M (cited to metenders, which on re-check does NOT contain that figure); lamar gives package value $118.53M and other trade sources put the whole Package-3 budget >$372M, so the $117M attribution to just the 40-km segment is uncertain. (c) ENDPOINTS blank in GEM ('Saudi Arabia'->'Saudi Arabia'); real named endpoints are BGCS #3 -> KM 245.2 (SRG-2 Section III), staged below.

routes.corridor_desc: SRG-2 Section III is a ~40 km, 56-in loop within Saudi Aramco's Shedgum->Riyadh gas transmission corridor, running from Booster Gas Compression Station BGCS #3 to chainage marker KM 245.2. The parent Shedgum-Riyadh Gas (SRG) corridor runs roughly WSW from the Shedgum/Uthmaniyah gas-plant area in the Eastern Province (~25.0 N, 49.3 E) toward Riyadh (~24.7 N, 46.7 E), a distance of ~400+ km; the KM 245.2 marker places this 40 km loop in the central-to-western part of that corridor, well inland of Shedgum and toward the Riyadh end. LOOSE BOUND ONLY: I could not source precise coordinates for BGCS #3 or the KM 245.2 chainage marker, so the segment endpoints are left null; the tightest defensible statement is that the loop lies along the Shedgum-Riyadh SRG trunk between roughly the 205 km and 245 km chainage, in the Eastern Province / eastern Riyadh Province interior.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints (BGCS #3 -> KM 245.2, SRG-2 SEC III) taken from the lamar EPC page. Corridor inferred from the named Shedgum->Riyadh SRG trunk; Shedgum plant and Riyadh coordinates are real, well-known place anchors used only to bound the corridor. No coordinate was fabricated for the actual segment endpoints (BGCS #3 / KM 245.2), which are left null because I could not source them; hence low suggested accuracy.

summary: P7715 confirmed (caveat): real Aramco MGSE Ph2 Pkg3 SRG-2 line, 40km/56in transmission, corroborated by 4 independent sources; caveats on StartYear (2021 vs contractor 2018) and unsubstantiated $117M cost ref.
